title: Pip and the Curly Shell
checkpoint: Reception Spring 2, week 2 — Learning — Phase 3: new sounds ar, or, ur

pages.text: Pip is up in the oak.
pages.illustration: Pip the sparrow perched high up on a branch of a big oak tree.

pages.text: Pip sees a thing. It is not a nut.
pages.illustration: Pip the sparrow looking closely at a small curled object wedged in the branch, clearly not a nut.

pages.text: Pip taps it. Pip turns it.
pages.illustration: Pip the sparrow pecking at the curled object and turning it over with his beak.
Close view of the object, a small pale shell with a tight spiral curl.
Pip the sparrow turning the pale shell one way, then the other, inspecting it from both sides.

pages.text: Is it a horn? Is it a shell?
pages.illustration: Pip the sparrow tilting his head, comparing the curled shell to a small horn-shaped twig beside it.
Pip the sparrow standing beside the pale spiral shell, having worked it out.

pages.text: Pip sits on the shell. Pip had fun.
pages.illustration: Pip the sparrow perched happily on top of the pale shell on the oak branch.
